voices.first_words: In this town, nobody is allowed outside at night.
voices.sounds_like: ElevenLabs 'Adam'-style adult male horror TTS (same as 006), ~90% sure
voices.timing_notes: Wall-to-wall ~1.15x-1.2x delivery (0:00.1-0:30.4) with zero breath pauses; slips 'a goofy ahh lie' deadpan into serious horror tone at 0:04.8; clips 'Nothing happens.' (0:08.2) and 'Ethan freezes.' (0:24.3) into staccato beats before the twist line (0:26.4-0:30.4) into the roar.

one_voice_plays_several_characters: yes — single male TTS voices both narration and the father's warning ('Don't you dare hurt my family, you monster!', 0:22.4-0:24.2) with no pitch/filter change, distinguished only by exclamation stress and the bat visual.

music.description: slowed dark ambient A-minor horror synth pad (-37 cents detuned) with low ominous drone
music.how_it_follows_the_story: Starts at 0:00.0 under the blood-red monster chase hook and loops steadily to 0:30.5 without dropping out, letting crying, door slams, and horror risers drive escalation to the 0:29.3 roar.

sound_effects.sound: deep cinematic horror boom with eerie monster rasp
low ominous rumble / dark wind drone
wooden front door creak and latch click
steady footsteps on quiet pavement (intermittent to 0:15.9)
tense high horror string stinger / metallic swell
rising dark horror drone / crackling static swell
bat clatter and fleeing rush whoosh

ambience: faint dark night wind / low horror drone under synth pad
sync_with_picture: ~19 cuts locked to horror foley: 0:00.1 boom hits blood-red chase hook; 0:06.2 creak matches opening door; 0:09.1-0:15.9 footsteps pace night walk; 0:11.8 string stinger hits terrified window faces; 0:16.5 sobbing hits weeping mother; file's loudest transient (0:20.1) slams as Dad bursts out with a bat; 0:27.3 distortion swell matches bleeding-eyed skull face; 0:29.3 roar erupts as shadow-beast Ethan towers over fleeing Dad.
faces_and_mouths: Static R6 mouths with instant 2D decal swaps on cuts: skeptical side-eye (0:04.0), Trollface grin (0:08.4), sweat (0:10.3), wide-eyed confusion (0:14.0), shock (0:24.4), bleeding-eyed analog-horror grin (0:27.3), and glowing-eyed black shadow beast (0:29.0); Dad's mouth stays static on his 0:22.4 line.
comedic_or_emotional_timing: Deadpan 'goofy ahh lie' (0:04.8) + Trollface grin (0:08.4) disarmingly lowers the viewer's guard before the explosive 0:20.1 door slam jolts into pure dread, holding the monster roar until the final words 'what he really is' (0:29.3-0:30.5).
first_3_seconds: Dark horror boom at 0:00.1, slowed detuned A-minor horror synth pad, and urgent male TTS ('In this town, nobody is allowed outside at night. Parents say it's because...') over a blood-red chase shot.
ending: Hard-cuts at 0:30.5 on 'what he really is' under a -13.1 dB monster screech; matching blood-red monster imagery, 0:00.1 horror boom, and identical synth pad create a seamless loop.
mix: Consistent mid-focused mix (-13.8 LUFS, flat LRA 1.5 LU, -0.3 dBTP) with 72.4% energy in 250 Hz-4 kHz (only 3.1% <80 Hz) so fast TTS, footsteps, sobs, 0:20.1 door bang, and 0:29.3 screech cut clearly on phone speakers.
why_the_sound_works: Zero-breath narration (1.5 LU LRA, zero silences) removes any natural swipe-away gap across 30.5s.
Deadpan 'goofy ahh lie' at 0:04.8 disarms viewers right before escalating into real horror foley.
Diegetic neighborhood cues (0:06.2 creak, 0:09.1 footsteps, 0:16.5 sobs, 0:20.1 door bang) ground the tension.
Withholding the monster screech until 0:29.3-0:30.5 pays off the twist right on the 0:00.0 loop seam.
unsure_about: Title of slowed detuned A-minor horror pad (identical to 012; left null); TTS elides 's' in 'that's' at 0:28.3.
